articles.title: SIU charges Halton police officer after shooting of Burlington, Ont., man in motel parking lot
articles.summary: A Halton police officer has been charged, according to the Ontario police watchdog, after shooting a 23-year-old man multiple times.

articles.summary: A fourth member of a Burlington family has died following a devastating townhouse fire that critically injured five people last weekend. articles.title: Mother in Burlington, Ont., house fire over the weekend has died, family friend says
articles.summary: Talika 'Tilly' Stuart was one of five people rescued from a house fire on Saturday. Her husband and two of her children, 12 and 1, died as a result of their injuries. A five-year-old child was also injured.

articles.title: This Etobicoke mall was transformed into the set of Netflix's latest game show
articles.summary: When Charles Wachter was tasked with finding a “fantasy mall” for Netflix’s new reality competition show, Win the Mall, he turned to his hometown shopping centre: Sherway Gardens in Etobicoke. But the showrunner says transforming the retail mecca into a game show set was a logistical challenge.

articles.title: Inquest into police-involved death of Jamal Francique shown videos from after shooting
articles.summary: The inquest into the death of a Black man shot by police in Mississauga in early 2020 is watching videos showing the officers around his wrecked car after the shooting.
